name: llm_error_rate_high
title: LLM call error rate above 10%
description: More than 10% of a service's model calls (chat, text_completion, generate_content, embeddings) ended with status ERROR in the last 10 minutes, with at least 20 calls. Provider outages, rate limits and expired keys show here first. Needs LLM spans in the traces stream named default; OpenObserve writes the gen_ai columns at ingest.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS error_pct FROM "default" WHERE gen_ai_operation_name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings') GROUP BY service_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 10
